instruction: Create a MariaDB user with full privileges
output: mariadb -u root -p -e "CREATE USER 'dev'@'%' IDENTIFIED BY 'devpass'; GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON *.* TO 'dev'@'%' WITH GRANT OPTION; FLUSH PRIVILEGES;"

instruction: Convert a MariaDB table to InnoDB
output: mariadb -u root -p mydb -e 'ALTER TABLE users ENGINE=InnoDB;'

instruction: Write data to InfluxDB using v1 API
Install and query Neo4j with cypher-shell
output: wget -qO- https://go.neo4j.com/download-thanks-core?edition=community&release=5.15.0&platform=linux&architecture=amd64&package=tar.gz | tar xz && mv neo4j-community-5.15.0 /opt/neo4j && /opt/neo4j/bin/cypher-shell -u neo4j -p password 'CREATE (:User {name:"John"})'
/opt/neo4j/bin/cypher-shell -u neo4j -p password 'CREATE INDEX user_name IF NOT EXISTS FOR (n:User) ON (n.name);'
apt install -y couchdb && curl -X PUT http://localhost:5984/_node/couchdb@localhost/_config/admins/admin -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '"password"'

instruction: Create a design document in CouchDB
Create a MergeTree table in ClickHouse
output: clickhouse-client --query 'CREATE TABLE mydb.events (event_date Date, event_type String, value UInt32) ENGINE = MergeTree() ORDER BY event_date'
clickhouse-client --query 'INSERT INTO mydb.events FORMAT CSV' < events.csv

instruction: Analyze ClickHouse query performance with EXPLAIN
output: clickhouse-client --query 'EXPLAIN SELECT event_type, count() FROM mydb.events WHERE event_date > today() - 7 GROUP BY event_type'

instruction: Install and configure Caddy reverse proxy for databases
output: apt install -y caddy && echo 'localhost:3306 { reverse_proxy 127.0.0.1:3306 }' > /etc/caddy/Caddyfile && systemctl restart caddy
psql -U postgres -c "SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state = 'idle' AND query_start < now() - interval '1 hour';"
